blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines–The work continues for Terrafirma’s Geo Chiu after wrapping up his rookie season in the PBA filled with highs and lows. Chiu acknowledges that he can still be a better version of himself based on what he experienced during the two-conference stint for the Dyip. “I’ll just continue putting in the work,” Chiu told The Inquirer after Terrafirma closed out the Governors’ Cup and the 50th season with a 149-117 rout of Titan Ultra on Saturday at Ynares Center in Antipolo. The No. 1 overall pick in the Rookie Draft had a rollercoaster season, highlighted by a 19-point, 23-rebound outing […]...
